stories.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models
stories.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.
stories.why: New coding-strong models change which assistants he can build agents on.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a lightweight model for agent execution
stories.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.
stories.why: Cheap agent models lower the cost of the automation projects he targets.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly moves ahead with IPO plans
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported the company is expected to set its valuation range this week.
stories.why: A big AI IPO signals continued hiring demand at frontier labs.

stories.title: Nvidia board opens investigation into Jensen Huang; stock slides more than 4%
stories.summary: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and the stock slid more than 4%.
stories.why: Nvidia shapes AI infrastructure spending, so turmoil there can move the market.

stories.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
stories.summary: Nominal, an AI platform for hardware engineering that claims Anduril as a major customer, raised another big round.
stories.why: Well-funded AI startups tend to hire engineers.

stories.title: Enza raises $6 million to expand across Africa's payments market
stories.summary: The round was led by 4DX Ventures with UK's BII; Enza provides payments infrastructure to banks and fintechs across Africa.
stories.why: African payments infrastructure is close to his fintech integration experience.

stories.title: Yoco taps $100 million credit facility for merchant cash advances
stories.summary: Yoco secured a $100 million facility from Victory Park Capital to expand merchant financing using payments data.
stories.why: Fintech lending built on payments data is a growing area for backend and data roles.

stories.title: Safaricom trains 6,000 employees in AI as it shifts toward technology
stories.summary: Safaricom has trained more than 6,000 employees in AI and machine learning as it moves from telecoms to a technology company.
stories.why: Signals Kenya's biggest employer investing in AI skills.
